A claim needs a verified email, an account at least 7 days old, at least 10 topics read, and at least 100 claimable sats, which the app treats as 1,000 unclaimed XP. The lifetime cap in the code is 15,000 sats, or 21,000 with premium, as of 2026, and the Lightning page can also connect with WebLN or NWC.
